question.text: Select the correct option, among Sc (III), Ti (IV), Pd (II) and Cu (II) ions

options.text: Sc (III), Ti (IV) are paramagnetic and Pd (III), Cu (II) are diamagnetic
Sc (III), Ti (IV) are diamagnetic and Pd (II), Cu (III) are paramagnetic

solution.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> are diamagnetic while <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>8</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>9</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> are paramagnetic.
